---
title: "Database schema"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# The sections below are db/README.md and db/MANIFEST.md, included so there is
# one copy to maintain.
include_md <- function(path, base, shift = 0L) {
  x <- readLines(path, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
  if (length(x) && grepl("^# ", x[1])) x <- x[-1]          # the article has its own title
  if (shift > 0L) x <- sub("^(#+) ", paste0("\\1", strrep("#", shift), " "), x)
  # links relative to the file's folder -> the file on GitHub
  x <- gsub("\\]\\((?!https?://|#)([^)]+)\\)", paste0("](", base, "\\1)"), x, perl = TRUE)
  knitr::asis_output(paste(x, collapse = "\n"))
}
base <- "https://github.com/immunoplex/i-spi-deployment/blob/main/db/"
```

The folder [`db/`](https://github.com/immunoplex/i-spi-deployment/tree/main/db)
creates the complete schema in an empty database: tables, views, functions,
triggers, and the default settings. An existing database is upgraded with
i-spi-compute's migrations instead; see [Upgrading](upgrading.html).

```{r, echo = FALSE}
include_md("../../db/README.md", base)
```

## Manifest

```{r, echo = FALSE}
include_md("../../db/MANIFEST.md", base, shift = 1L)
```
